decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-C590-09 with a hydraulic failure. The radio and OT-5100 agree (repair on site, 3 to 5 h, likely 4 h), so no confirmation is needed. Central is truck-limited. I estimated truck throughput at about 90 t/h, from 4 trucks, a cycle of about 0.4 h, 40 t payload and factor 0.227. The three remaining Central loaders (LH-02, LH-04, LH-05) muck about 35.6 + 35.6 + 38.5 = 110 t/h, which is already more than the trucks can haul. The Central stockpile holds 297 t of its 450 t capacity. Losing LH-01 therefore costs almost no hauled ounces, and a replacement loader would only add to the stockpile. Candidate lenders are poor. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until about 10:00. Norte is 6 km away over the surface road, so a loan there would arrive late and add little. The producing loaders at Norte and Este are needed at home. Taking LH-08 or LH-09 from the Este development headings costs 0.4 or 5.7 oz per hour. No stope was stopped, so there are no reserve activations. Net change versus doing nothing is about 0 oz, so I recommend no moves.
